anchor: case width = 43.0 mm (Tissot official), coin-edge circle on the flanks

bezel_notches.basis: square teeth about 29 px apart at the rim

indices.layout: applied polished frames with lume: triangle at 12, bars at 3 and 9, short bar at 6, dots elsewhere

artefacts_not_traced: the render is 19.4 px/mm: hand and index edges are +-2 px (+-0.1 mm)

the minute tail lies under the seconds hand; its width is an estimate
the date window (round, with 8) stays in the dial map
